item.title: Sports Briefs: MC girls rally for playoff win
item.description: No. 7 seed Marin Catholic edged No. 10 Ukiah with a 46-41 road victory in Wednesday’s NCS D-II opener. The Wildcats (12-14) advance to Saturday’s quarterfinals against either No. 2 Moreau Catholic or No. 15 Fortuna.
